options.label: Auto: high contrast where the panel shows no color
Hard: less time at each checkpoint
Day, dusk and night, a lap each
Off: keys, buttons or touching the road

fields.name: buttons
fields.label: Buttons
fields.value: LEFT=left, RIGHT=right, PREV=left, NEXT=right, UP=a, DOWN=b, OK=a, KEY1=a, BUTTON=a, BOOT=a, AI=a, KEY2=b, HOME=b, REFRESH=start, KEY3=start
fields.description: Which GPIO key does what: LABEL=action, with left, right, a (gas), b (brake) and start (pause). A key not named here is gas.

roadRacer.name: Road racer
roadRacer.description: A pseudo-3D race against the clock drawn in the 8-bit palette mode: curves, hills, traffic and checkpoints, for touch, keys and GPIO buttons.
